jsonld.title: Senior  Software Engineer C++
jsonld.description:
Senior C++ Software Engineer - AI & Engineering Software

Location: Central London, primarily office-based with some flexibility

We're partnering with an AI startup building software to help engineers design and develop physical products faster. Combining machine learning with complex engineering software, their platform helps bring new hardware ideas closer to production.

They're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer to take ownership of core software as the company moves from research prototypes into customer deployments. This is a hands-on opportunity to shape the architecture, improve performance, and build the foundations of an evolving product.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and develop production software in C++, working closely with researchers and software engineers.

  • Shape the platform's architecture, defining clear interfaces between its computational engine, Python backend, CAD integrations, and user interface.

  • Turn research prototypes into reliable, testable, and maintainable product capabilities.

  • Identify performance bottlenecks and improve computational efficiency, including GPU execution where relevant.

  • Reduce complexity in the codebase and make it easier to introduce new features and customer integrations.

  • Translate evolving product and research requirements into practical technical decisions, taking work from initial design through implementation.

What we're looking for

  • Strong commercial C++ experience and a track record of delivering high-quality production software.

  • Experience owning substantial components or building complex software products end-to-end.

  • Sound architectural judgement around interfaces, testing, performance, and technical debt.

  • Confidence working through ambiguous problems and explaining the trade-offs behind your decisions.

  • The ability to work across different technologies, with Python experience particularly useful.

  • A self-motivated approach and enthusiasm for working closely with a small, highly technical team.

Experience that would stand out

  • Game engines, graphics, rendering, CAD, computational geometry, simulation, robotics, or scientific software.

  • GPU programming, CUDA, or other performance-sensitive computing.

  • Integrating components written in different languages.

  • Taking research-led software into production.

  • A personal interest in hardware, engineering, or building things.

You don't need a PhD or a mechanical engineering background. We're interested in engineers who can demonstrate strong coding skills, thoughtful technical decisions, and ownership of software that works in practice.

Why join?

You'll have significant influence over the codebase and technical direction at an early stage, working alongside researchers tackling challenging engineering problems. There's scope to grow into broader architectural ownership as the product and team expand.

Interested? Get in touch to discuss the role.

jsonld.title: Senior Software Engineer (C++ / Defence Systems)

jsonld.title: Senior/C++ Software Engineer - Selby Jennings
jsonld.description:
A leading global electronic trading and market-making firm is expanding its engineering teams and is seeking experienced C++ engineers to work on some of the most performance-critical systems in the industry.

Unlike traditional software roles, opportunities exist across multiple business lines and technology stacks, allowing engineers to focus on the areas that best align with their interests and expertise. Teams are responsible for building and optimising the systems that power global trading operations across a broad range of asset classes.



What You'll Work On

Depending on team alignment and experience, responsibilities may include:

  • Designing and developing ultra-low-latency order entry systems.
  • Building and optimising options trading platforms.
  • Developing market data infrastructure and exchange connectivity.
  • Improving execution performance through deep systems-level optimisation.
  • Creating scalable distributed systems that process vast amounts of real-time data.
  • Working closely with traders, quantitative researchers, and fellow engineers to solve complex technical challenges.
  • Driving architectural decisions and contributing to the technical direction of critical trading platforms.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong commercial experience with modern C++.
  • Expertise in performance optimisation, multithreading, concurrency, and Linux.
  • Strong understanding of systems programming fundamentals.
  • Experience building highly performant, business-critical software.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for engineering excellence.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.


Beneficial Experience

  • Low-latency trading systems.
  • Exchange connectivity and market data.
  • Options or derivatives trading technology.
  • Network optimisation and kernel bypass technologies.
  • High-performance distributed systems.
  • Financial markets, trading, or quantitative environments.


Why Join?

  • Work alongside world-class engineers, quantitative researchers, and traders.
  • Significant ownership and direct impact on revenue-generating systems.
  • A highly technical engineering culture where performance and innovation are valued.
  • Opportunities across multiple trading desks and business areas.
  • Access to challenging technical problems at exceptional scale.
  • Competitive compensation, bonus potential, and long-term career growth.

This is an excellent opportunity for senior C++ engineers who enjoy solving complex performance challenges and want to build technology that sits directly at the heart of global financial markets.

£60,000 to 75,000 GBP

Bonus

Onsite WORKING

Location: Central London, Greater London - United Kingdom Type: Permanent

Software Engineer - C++ / Rust

Location: Cambridge

Salary: Up to £75,000 + bonus

Level: Consultant / Senior Consultant

Security: Must be eligible for UK Security Clearance

The Opportunity

We're looking for Software Engineers with experience in C++ or Rust to join an innovative technology team developing advanced network security products.

You'll work on specialist software and hardware solutions designed to protect critical digital infrastructure across defence, security, energy and the public sector. This is an opportunity to contribute to technically challenging projects with real-world impact, working on products that address complex security requirements.

You'll join a highly skilled engineering team where software is developed in-house, with a strong emphasis on technical quality, collaboration and continuous improvement. From enhancing existing products to developing next-generation capabilities, you'll have the opportunity to make a tangible contribution to the direction of the technology.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop and maintain high-quality software for advanced network security products.
  • Contribute to the development of secure, reliable and maintainable applications.
  • Work across a range of technologies, including low-level software, Linux-based applications and embedded systems.
  • Collaborate with other engineers through code reviews, pair programming and technical discussions.
  • Apply modern software engineering practices, including test-driven development (TDD) and Agile methodologies.
  • Help improve development processes, software quality and engineering standards.
  • Contribute to technical problem-solving across complex software and security challenges.
  • Work collaboratively across the wider business, with opportunities to engage in customer support and other technical activities.
Essential Skills & Experience

We're interested in engineers with approximately 2-5 years of software engineering experience, gained through relevant professional experience and/or qualifications.

You should have experience in some of the following areas:
  • C++ (modern C++ and STL) or Rust.
  • Python development.
  • Linux application development.
  • Bare-metal programming, embedded systems or real-time operating systems.
  • Cloud application development.
  • Network security or secure communications.
Interested?

If you're a Software Engineer with experience in C++ or Rust and want to work on challenging, security-focused technology with real-world applications, we'd like to hear from you.

Please note: Candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance.

jsonld.title: Team Lead - C++ Quant Development  London- Global Hedge Fund
jsonld.description:
Salary: £600-800k target range

Summary:

My client is one of the world's most prestigious hedge funds. They have a unique and exciting opportunity for an experienced, hands-on Team Lead to contribute to their continued success.

As the London Team Lead, you will lead and mentor a small team of Quantitative Developers, providing technical guidance and driving the overall direction of the team while remaining highly hands-on. You'll play a key role in the design, architecture and implementation of low-latency C++ systems that are not only robust, resilient and accurate, but also exceptionally fast and efficient.

The successful Team Lead will be an exceptional communicator, with the confidence to work directly with central trading teams to optimise the firm's overall execution performance. You will need to be a strong technologist, but also have an excellent understanding of trading and the commercial impact of technology, with the ability to build strong relationships across the business.

  • 12+ years' experience in hands-on software development, including 7+ years within front-office financial markets
  • Proven track record as a senior contributor or technical lead
  • Deep-level OO programming skills in C++, including C++17/20 and multithreaded/asynchronous environments
  • Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms, as well as low-latency and real-time system design
  • Strong understanding of electronic trading and execution systems
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working directly with trading teams
  • Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Engineering or another quantitative discipline

Rewards and Incentives:
  • Significant salary + bonus and opportunities for growth
  • Greenfield work with significant impact in a highly visible and high-profile area of the business
  • Highly collaborative culture where strong technical ideas are implemented
  • Senior leadership position while remaining genuinely hands-on
